messages:
cleo: quick heads-up: planning a tiny canary for comet-lite-6b:v2 in the 01:00-02:00 UTC window. plan: 4% for 10m then 20% if green.
ben: can we pin gov and paid tenants to comet-lite-6b:v1 for the first 30m?
cleo: yes. ben please apply pin TTL 1h.
ben: done: POST /catalog/pin {"selector":"(gov|paid)","model":"comet-lite-6b:v1","ttl":"1h"} verified.
sre-ops: fallback order proposed: 1) tenant pin, 2) comet-lite-6b:v1, 3) ember-6b-quant. rollback triggers: p95 > 900ms OR errors > baseline*2 for 5m OR qps drop > 12% for 2m. page if p95 > 1200ms.
cleo: deploy-bot, queue the micro-enable and attach the monitors + runbook.
deploy-bot: queued: /run deploy catalog enable comet-lite-6b:v2 --micro 4% --window=2026-04-10T01:00Z-02:00Z --monitors=p50,p95,errors,qps --runbook=https://confluence/redwood/comet-lite-rollout
ops-bot: reminder: changewindow booking confirmed; owners: @cleo @ben.
cleo: preflight checklist: smoke eval ready, pins applied, oncall ack. assigning oncall: @ben primary @sre-ops backup.
ben: ack. i'll be onpager.
cleo: starting canary at +7m to let pins propagate. will post brief snapshots.
deploy-bot: starting micro canary now. will post snapshots at +5m and +15m.
sre-ops: +5m: p50=90ms p95=310ms errors=baseline. no alerts.
cleo: scaling to 20% after steady.
deploy-bot: scaling to 20% now.
sre-ops: +10m after scale: p95=360ms errors flat. no page.
cleo: if anything spikes use this rollback snippet:
```
/run deploy catalog set-traffic --model=comet-lite-6b:v2 --percent=0
/run deploy catalog rollback --model=comet-lite-6b:v2 --to=comet-lite-6b:v1 --reason="canary-failure"
POST /catalog/pin {"selector":"paid","model":"comet-lite-6b:v1","ttl":"1h"}
```
ben: all good here. i'll remove pins in 45m if stable and update changelog.
cleo: thanks team, will post release note to #release-notes after window."
